The expansion reflects Sift's effort to position itself between two California talent pools: hardware builders in Los Angeles, and software, distributed systems and artificial intelligence talent in San Francisco. Sift's pitch is that the rise of AI-enabled hardware is creating demand for observability tools that are common in software but less developed in industries such as launch systems, satellites, autonomous transport and defence. Sift sells data infrastructure and observability software for hardware systems in aerospace, defence, autonomy, rail and advanced manufacturing.
